title: A One-Ton Bison Can Clear a Five-Foot Fence
subject: american bison

scenes.text: A ton of animal can still jump a five-foot fence.
Bison bulls weigh up to 2,000 pounds and stand five to six feet tall.
They can run up to 35 miles an hour, as fast as traffic on a city street.
They can also jump over objects about five feet high, which is why park rangers keep people far away.
In 1800 there were an estimated 40 million bison. By 1900, fewer than a thousand were left.
Rangers say stay 25 yards back. Now you know why.
